🌟 tuios | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an advanced, efficient, and agent-aware terminal environment for developers, streamlining workflows and enhancing productivity through window management, session persistence, and inter-agent communication.
✨ Key Features: • Terminal multiplexer and window manager • Vim-like modal interface • Multiple terminal panes and workspaces • BSP tiling • Kitty graphics protocol support
📖 Summary: TUIOS is a Go-based terminal multiplexer and window manager that enhances productivity with a vim-like interface, BSP tiling, and advanced features for managing coding agents. It offers persistent sessions, cross-machine connectivity, and an inbox for agent communication, all within the terminal.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 Strata | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling users to run advanced AI models locally on their personal computers without requiring server infrastructure.
✨ Key Features: • Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on consumer hardware • One-click install for Windows/Linux • OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility on localhost • Optional image input support • All processing stays on the user's PC
📖 Summary: Strata is a C++ inference engine that allows users to run the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next AI model on consumer hardware, such as Windows or Linux PCs with NVIDIA or AMD graphics cards. It provides an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API on localhost and supports optional image input, ensuring all processing remains on the user's machine.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 git-secret | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: Securely managing and storing sensitive configuration files, API keys, or other secrets within a version-controlled Git repository, accessible only by authorized team members.
✨ Key Features: • Stores private data in a git repository • Encrypts files with permitted users' public keys
📖 Summary: git-secret is a bash tool designed to securely store sensitive data within a Git repository. It encrypts files using the public keys of authorized users, ensuring that only those with the corresponding private keys can decrypt and access the information. This simplifies access management and revoking permissions without needing to re-encrypt all secrets.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ x-ui-pro | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: Bypassing internet censorship and restrictions by setting up a secure, multi-protocol reverse proxy server with advanced features and ease of installation.
✨ Key Features: • Handles WebSocket/GRPC/HttpUpgrade/XHTTP via nginx • Supports multiple users and configurations on port 443 • Allows installation of multiple domains on a single server • Enhances security and reduces detection with nginx • Automated SSL renewal and daily service reloads
📖 Summary: XUI-PRO is a shell script that automates the installation and configuration of a secure web proxy server. It integrates various protocols and tools like nginx, xray, v2rayA, Cloudflare, Tor, and Psiphon to bypass internet restrictions and enhance network security.
